**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (¶¶ p0073–p0074) satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** level:

| Preferred requirement | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ § 18.1 |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ § 18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✅ § 18.1 |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ § 18.1 |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

Vendor-favourable extras also present in our favour: employer's liability USD 1M, coverage extending one year past the term, reputable-insurer requirement, primacy over Customer's insurance where commercially customary, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities.

Minor sub-elements noted in the rationale rather than flagged, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics: notice of cancellation or material reduction is qualified by "to the extent available from its insurer," and primacy is qualified by "where commercially customary." Neither affects a material term (coverage types, limits, duration, certificates), so neither warrants a redline.
